IS: 7166 -1985 



Indian Standard 



( Reaffirmed 2003 ) 




SPECIFICATION FOR 
CELLULOSE SECONDARY ACETATE FLAKES 

( First Revision ) 



1. Scope— Prescribes the requirements and methods of sampling and test for cellulose secondary 
acetate flakes. 

2. Terminology— For the purpose of this standard definitions given in IS : 2828-1964 'Glossary 
of terms used in plastics industry' shall be applicable. 

3. Grades — The material shall be of the following two grades: 

a) Grade 1 — For rayon industry; and 

b) Grade 2— For plastics industry. 

4. Requirements 

4.1 Description — The material shall be in the form of dry, white, finely ground or unground flakes 
as agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier and free from visible impurities. 

4.2 The material shall also comply with the requirements given in Table 1.

5 B Packing and Marking 

5.1 Packing — The material shall be packed as agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. 

5.2 Marking — The packing shall be marked with the following information: 

a) Name of the material; 
h) Grade; 

c) Name of the manufacturer or his trade-mark; 

d) Mass of the package; and 

e) Month and year of manufacture. 

5.2.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 
6. Sampling — The sampling shall be done as prescribed in 3 of IS : 7188 - 1974.
